_comment: The single resume content, held constant across every fixture. Fictional person. Phone/location formats are deliberately ones both oracles can parse at baseline (both are US-centric: 3-3-4 digit groups, 'City, ST'), so that fixtures have headroom to lose accuracy rather than starting at zero.
